Hi Samantha — appreciate the heads-up and the attachment. Short answers up front: yes we can consolidate packages, and we support mid-contract top-ups with pro-rata billing or an annualize-and-trueup approach.

I'll have Ben put together two options you can show procurement:

2) Annualize + co-term: move to a single annual committed bucket with a blended discount and a one-time credit for unused legacy seats.

Subject: Redwood pricing options (v3) — initial worksheet attached

Samantha / Logan,

Attached is pricing_options_v3.xlsx with three scenarios and line-item math:
A) Top-up (mid-contract) — list pricing on new units, pro-rated first invoice, no change to contract term.
B) Annualize with co-term — blended rate across legacy + new units, 8% blended discount at current commit level, step-up discounts if you commit to 20%+ additional units.
C) Consolidate + staggered annualize — a hybrid where we move billing to quarterly and apply a tiered credit to legacy seats over 6 months.

Notes / tradeoffs:
- Pro-rated top-up is fastest; procurement can approve within a PO cycle but you keep fragmentation in invoicing.
- Annualize/co-term gives the lowest unit cost but requires procurement/legal lead time (~2–3 weeks).
- Consolidation + staged credit smooths invoice impact for your finance team and preserves some discount.

I included estimate rows for your 35% growth case. See tab 'sensitivity' for +/- 10% variance.

(attachment: redwood_pricing_options_v3.xlsx (xlsx, 62KB))

Happy to talk through the numbers on Thursday.

—Ben

Hi Gina / Samantha,

Thanks for the clarity on cadence and timeline. Quick commercial proposal to get legal started:

- Packaging consolidation: move existing seats + dedicated capacity into a single 'Committed Inference Units' (CIU) SKU.
- Credit schedule for legacy seats: a 6-month amortized credit applied monthly against the CIU charge. Credit amounts are calculated as (legacy_unit_price - blended_CIU_price) * legacy_units / 6.
- Proration: any top-up executed mid-month will be invoiced pro-rata, and the first full-billing month will be charged at the new CIU rate.
- SLA: consolidated package includes standard Redwood Dedicated SLAs (99.9% uptime) and a one-step escalation to priority support for an annual fee waiver for 12 months.

I've attached a short draft 'packaging_consolidation_draft.pdf' with sample contract language we typically hand to legal. Kimberly — can you validate the credit clause and confirm we can offer a 6-month amortization in our commercial template?

Jordan
Jordan Blake
